prompt:
A 3x2 sprite sheet of Fang, Rubeus Hagrid's enormous black boarhound from the Harry Potter books, in charming chunky 16-bit pixel art style identical to the reference Hagrid sprite sheet. Fang is drawn as a cute chunky chibi boarhound: big expressive head, deep drooping jowls with a hint of drool, floppy triangular ears, gentle warm brown eyes, heavy muscular chibi body with a sleek black coat shaded with subtle cool charcoal tones, and a wide dark brown leather collar with a brass buckle. All sprites are in three-quarter view facing lower-left, perfectly consistent in scale, proportions, and colors, framed with thick dark #231F2E pixel art outlines and illuminated from top-left. Crisp pure white background, no floor shadows, no dividing lines, no text. Generous spacing between cells, feet aligned along a straight horizontal baseline in each row.

Grid arrangement (3 columns by 2 rows):
Row 1 (left to right):
1. sit: Fang sitting upright on his haunches facing lower-left, mouth closed, calm and gentle expression, tongue tucked in.
2. blink: identical sitting sprite to frame 1 in exact pixel placement, with both eyes softly shut in a blink.
3. pant: identical sitting pose, mouth open in a goofy pant, bright pink tongue hanging out to the side with slobber.

Row 2 (left to right):
4. wag: identical sitting pose, both ears perked up attentively, tail happily wagging to the opposite side.
5. lie: Fang lying flat on his belly sleeping, front paws forward with chin resting comfortably on paws, eyes peacefully shut.
6. stand: Fang standing stoutly on all four legs facing lower-left, tail held upright.
